{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
filtered = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
